summary.text: Gabriel Ramos is a Republican who represents District 28 in the New Mexico Senate, covering Grant, Hidalgo and Luna counties.
The legislature's member page lists Ramos as a senator from 2019 to 2020 and again since 2025, and as ranking member of the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Ramos's occupation as insurance agent and a district office in Silver City.

Ramos also sits on the Senate Tax, Business and Transportation Committee and, between sessions, on the New Mexico Finance Authority Oversight Committee and the Revenue Stabilization and Tax Policy Committee.
